Browser-only behaviour reduced to explicit native-safe unavailable states and documented: (1) @/lib/draftIndex is localStorage-backed for crash recovery -- RN has no localStorage and AsyncStorage is not a dependency, so the registry is in-memory only and empty on a fresh launch, meaning the prompt does not surface until a host registers a draft. (2) @/lib/broadcast BroadcastChannel cross-tab bus -- a single-instance native app has no sibling tabs, so subscribeBroadcast is a no-op and the grace-period active-set is always empty. (3) sessionStorage one-shot guard -> module-level flag for the runtime lifetime. (4) react-router navigate + window.location.assign -> onNavigate bridge, no hard-navigation fallback.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, react-router-dom, lucide-react, recharts, leaflet, or web @/components/ui imports in the native output -- only react, react-native, the native AppText, and theme tokens.
